Apps for Tivione IPTV

Use the player you know and follow the credential details supplied after your subscription is activated.

IBO Player

Install from your device app store, open the app and use the device ID and key to add your subscription details.

TiviMate

Add a playlist in TiviMate, select Xtream Codes or M3U as instructed, then enter the server details securely.

IPTV Smarters Pro

Choose Xtream Codes API and add the username, password and server URL received from support.

XCIPTV

Open the player, select account login and enter your credentials exactly as supplied.

Smart ONE

Activate the app on your Smart TV and add the playlist connection information provided for your line.
